name: public-web
description: Code exposed to untrusted external/user input (web endpoints, parsers of third-party data, anything internet-facing). FULL threat model — do NOT suppress security/DoS findings here.
provenance: Input may come from anonymous external users or third-party systems.
threat_model: Assume hostile input: injection (SQL/XSS/SSRF/command), auth bypass, resource exhaustion, and unbounded/large payloads are ALL in scope and reachable. Flag them as blocking when they affect the goal.
scale: Unbounded — inputs can be large and crafted; algorithmic-complexity/DoS IS a real reachable threat here.
invariants: Do not recommend a change that loses valid data, but DO recommend bounded/streaming handling for untrusted large input
